ei.title: 8번: The Eye: A Mysterious Floating Island
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: In the Parana Delta near Buenos Aires, Argentina, is a small island called "The Eye," which floats in the middle of a small lake that is about 120 meters in diameter. It was accidentally discovered by Argentinian film director Sergio Neuspiller during the pre-production for a horror film about extraterrestrials. Interestingly, both the island and the lake are perfectly circular. What's more, the lake that surrounds the island is extremely cold and clear — an unusual phenomenon for the area. So mysterious is the island that people have wondered if it was created naturally or by aliens. Since its discovery, researchers have found out that the circular shape might be due to slow-moving water currents flowing to one side of the island. But there is still no explanation for the lake's unusually cold, clear water.

questions.passage: In the Parana Delta near Buenos Aires, Argentina, is a small island called "The Eye," which (A)[floats / sinks] in the middle of a small lake that is about 120 meters in diameter. It was accidentally discovered by Argentinian film director Sergio Neuspiller during the pre-production for a horror film about extraterrestrials. Interestingly, both the island and the lake are perfectly circular. What's more, the lake that (B)[divides / surrounds] the island is extremely cold and clear — an unusual phenomenon for the area. So (C)[mysterious / ordinary] is the island that people have wondered if it was created naturally or by aliens. Since its discovery, researchers have found out that the circular shape might be due to slow-moving water currents flowing to one side of the island. But there is still no explanation for the lake's unusually cold, clear water.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) floats=(물에) 뜨다 / sinks=가라앉다 (B) surrounds=둘러싸다 / divides=나누다 (C) mysterious=신비한 / ordinary=평범한
det.analysis:
① sinks—surrounds—mysterious: (A) 섬은 호수에 '떠(floats)' 있지 가라앉지 않아요
② floats—surrounds—mysterious: 섬이 호수에 뜨고(floats), 호수가 섬을 둘러싸며(surrounds), 사람들이 외계인 얘기를 할 만큼 신비함(mysterious) ←정답
③ floats—divides—ordinary: (B) 호수는 섬을 '나누는(divides)' 게 아니라 '둘러싼다(surrounds)' (C) 평범(ordinary)하지 않고 신비함
④ sinks—divides—mysterious: (A)(B) 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 섬이 뜸(floats) → 호수가 둘러쌈(surrounds) → 외계인 얘기가 나올 만큼 신비함(mysterious)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) accidentally=우연히 / deliberately=의도적으로 (B) perfectly=완벽하게 / partly=부분적으로 (C) researchers=연구자들 / tourists=관광객들
det.analysis:
① deliberately—perfectly—researchers: (A) 공포영화 사전 제작 중 '우연히(accidentally)' 발견했어요

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) extremely=극도로 / slightly=약간 (B) naturally=자연적으로 / artificially=인공적으로 (C) slow-moving=느리게 흐르는 / fast-moving=빠르게 흐르는

③ extremely—artificially—fast-moving: (B) 자연 vs 외계인 대비이므로 '자연적으로(naturally)' (C) 느린 물살

det.korean: current: (A) (물의) 흐름·해류(명사) (B) 현재의·지금의(형용사)
det.analysis:
① (A) (물의) 흐름 (B) 현재의: (A)는 섬을 미는 물살(underwater currents)이라 '흐름', (B)는 the current owner(현재의 소유주)라 '현재의' ←정답
② (A) 현재의 (B) 흐름: (A)(B) 뜻이 뒤바뀜
③ (A) 전류 (B) 유행: (A)는 물의 흐름이지 전류가 아님
④ (A) (물의) 흐름 (B) 전류: (B) current owner는 '전류 소유주'가 아니라 '현재의 소유주'
det.tip: current의 다의어: (물의) 흐름(명사) vs 현재의(형용사, the current owner)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a person who studies a subject carefully in order to discover new facts"

det.korean: tourist=관광객 / artist=예술가 / director=감독 / researcher=연구자
det.analysis:
① tourist: 관광객 — 새로운 사실을 연구하는 사람이 아님
② artist: 예술가 — 연구가 본업이 아님
③ director: 감독 — 영화 등을 지휘하는 사람
④ researcher: 새로운 사실을 발견하려 주제를 신중히 연구하는 사람 ←정답
det.tip: studies ... to discover new facts = 연구자(researcher)

questions.passage: Since its discovery, researchers have found out that the circular shape might be due to slow-moving water currents __________ (flow) to one side of the island. But there is still no explanation for the lake's unusually cold, clear water.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: flow(흐르다) → flowing. 앞의 명사 currents를 뒤에서 꾸미는 현재분사
det.analysis: flow를 현재분사 flowing으로 바꿔요. 'water currents __________ to one side'는 물살이 한쪽으로 '흐르는' 능동의 뜻이에요. 앞의 명사 currents(물살)를 뒤에서 꾸미는 현재분사라서 flowing이 맞아요. (currents가 스스로 흐르는 능동이라 -ing형이에요.)
det.tip: 명사 뒤에서 꾸미며 능동(흐르는)의 뜻 → 현재분사 flowing

questions.passage: What's more, the lake that surrounds the island is extremely cold and clear — an unusual phenomenon for the area. So __________ (mystery) is the island that people have wondered if it was created naturally or by aliens.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: mystery(신비, 명사) → mysterious(신비한, 형용사). 'So + 형용사' 자리
det.analysis: 명사 mystery를 형용사 mysterious로 바꿔요. 'So __________ is the island that ~'은 원래 'The island is so mysterious that ~(그 섬은 너무 신비해서 ~)' 문장을 강조하려고 So+형용사를 앞으로 보낸 거예요. 그래서 빈칸에는 형용사 mysterious가 와야 해요. (mystery: 신비 → mysterious: 신비한)
det.tip: So + 형용사 ~ that 구문. 명사 mystery → 형용사 mysterious

questions.passage: In the Parana Delta near Buenos Aires, Argentina, is a small island called "The Eye," which floats in the middle of a small lake that is about 120 meters in diameter. It was accidentally discovered by Argentinian film director Sergio Neuspiller during the pre-production for a horror film about extraterrestrials. Interestingly, both the island and the lake are perfectly circular. What's more, the lake that surrounds the island is extremely cold and clear — __________ for the area. So mysterious is the island that people have wondered if it was created naturally or by aliens. Since its discovery, researchers have found out that the circular shape might be due to slow-moving water currents flowing to one side of the island. But there is still no explanation for the lake's unusually cold, clear water.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: a common event=흔한 사건 / a famous tourist spot=유명한 관광지 / an unusual phenomenon=특이한 현상 / a dangerous place=위험한 장소
det.analysis:
빈칸 앞 '극도로 차갑고 맑은 물(extremely cold and clear)'과 'What's more(게다가)'가 단서예요.
① a common event: 흔한 사건? 앞의 '특이함'과 반대
② a famous tourist spot: 유명한 관광지? 물의 특성과 무관
③ an unusual phenomenon: 그 지역에서 보기 드문 '특이한 현상' ←정답
④ a dangerous place: 위험한 장소? 본문 근거 없음
det.tip: 극도로 차갑고 맑은 물 → 그 지역엔 특이한 현상(an unusual phenomenon)

questions.passage: In the Parana Delta near Buenos Aires, Argentina, is a small island called "The Eye," which floats in the middle of a small lake that is about 120 meters in diameter. It was accidentally discovered by Argentinian film director Sergio Neuspiller during the pre-production for a horror film about extraterrestrials. Interestingly, both the island and the lake are perfectly circular. What's more, the lake that surrounds the island is extremely cold and clear — an unusual phenomenon for the area. So mysterious is the island that people have wondered if it was __________. Since its discovery, researchers have found out that the circular shape might be due to slow-moving water currents flowing to one side of the island. But there is still no explanation for the lake's unusually cold, clear water.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: forgotten long ago=오래전 잊힌 / drawn on old maps=옛 지도에 그려진 / sold to rich tourists=부유한 관광객에게 팔린 / created naturally or by aliens=자연적으로 또는 외계인에 의해 만들어진
det.analysis:
빈칸 앞 'So mysterious(너무 신비해서)'와 'people have wondered if it was(사람들이 ~인지 궁금해했다)'가 단서예요.
① forgotten long ago: 오래전 잊힘? 사람들이 궁금해하는 내용과 안 맞음
② drawn on old maps: 옛 지도? 본문 근거 없음
③ sold to rich tourists: 관광객에게 팔림? 문맥 무관
④ created naturally or by aliens: 너무 신비해서 '자연적으로 생겼는지 외계인이 만들었는지' 궁금해함 ←정답
det.tip: 너무 신비함 → 자연적으로/외계인이 만들었는지(created naturally or by aliens) 궁금
